title: CvPage
description: data/cv/page.yaml: the CV page's header, its title and description, the email in two parts and the timeline's last month (specs/004-interactive-cv/data-model.md, Page). Written by scripts/import-cv.ts from approved text only; a hand edit breaks the approval hash. Messages never quote a value (contracts/content-files.md, Messages).

name.description: The owner's name as the page heading. Hashed.

headline.description: One line under the name. Hashed.

location.description: Where the owner is based, in words. Hashed.

title.description: The page's <title>. At most 60 characters, checked by validate.ts's budgets so the message gives the count. Hashed.

description.description: The meta and share description. At most 160 characters (budgets). Hashed.

email_user.description: The part of the address before the @. Never written joined in the HTML (FR-003). Hashed.
email_user.x-error: is not the first part of an email address (lower-case letters, digits and . _ + - between them)

email_domain.description: The part of the address after the @. Hashed.
email_domain.x-error: is not a domain (lower-case labels joined by dots, such as example.com)

linkedin.description: Optional link to the owner's LinkedIn profile. Hashed.
linkedin.x-error: is not a LinkedIn profile link (expected https://www.linkedin.com/in/<name>)

as_of.description: YYYY-MM: the month the timeline runs to, and the page's data date. Months in a `when` are allowed only in its year. Hashed.

listed.description: false while the page is unlisted (FR-004): noindex, out of the sitemap and linked from nowhere. A setting, not hashed.

sharing_rules_confirmed.description: The date the owner last re-confirmed the sharing rules (FR-023), carried from the export. Not hashed.
